reviews.title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS, AMERICANS
reviews.text:
Good grief, where do I start.. all I wanted to do was make friends and chat with Korean people because I enjoy what I've seen of their culture from watching KBS, and this app was recommended by a google search after a disastrous experience with K-Dating ..long story short, everyone who contacted me insisted on me using WhatsApp bcuz they claimed it's "easier" to chat there -which it ISN'T but it DOES expose your phone number (used as your ID and a verification code is required for signup so you can't keep your number private if you want to sign up).. guys on this app tend to use "stock" photos found on the net instead of real photos and ask YOU a lot of questions but don't answer YOUR questions, and if that doesn't tell you they're potential scammers, nothing will.
The whole thing is a huge disappointment to me as all I wanted to do was just make friends from a culture I find interesting; I'm a grandma, I'm not looking for a hookup or be a Sugar Mama! I just wanted to CHAT with an actual, honest person or two, and learn things like what's this "Chair King" I've seen/heard of in KBS programs that a foreigner like me wouldn't know the meaning of, y'know?
So sincerely, if you're an American, they'll eat you alive and I highly, HIGHLY recommend you avoid this app.. and K-Dating .. and Line.. I think they're all owned by the same "company" so watch out!
As for me.. I give up.. this stress ain't worth it!
